description: Amplify your trail-game with the all-new Fourstroke AMP LT built to perform on every terrain. This advanced XC performance machine delivers a progressive riding feel with 120mm of revolutionized APS dual-link suspension travel. Hidden trail-racing power comes curtesy of the trailblazing TQ-HPR50 drive system for nonstop uphill and downhill speed to make sure nothing stands in your way. The full-carbon frame includes our most progressive Big Wheel Concept Race geometry to accommodate two water bottles, an integrated fork stopper and frame protection. Charge the trails with Fourstroke AMP LT ONE USA arriving with a SRAM Gx Eagle AXS drivetrain, RockShox SID SL Select+ fork and RockShox SIDLuxe Select+ shock, a DT Swiss XRC 1501 wheelset with 30mm inner width, Bikeyoke Divine seatpost and the powerful TQ-HPR50 drive unit.
